title: T3 — Gap analysis
body:
# T3 — Gap analysis

## Baseline

Before the record was completed, T3 was closed without a baseline, a delivery contract or a Phase-G
review: the PM path had code but no governed record.

## Target

The T3 gate: PM runs a request end to end; cannot approve its own gate; a baseline change requires
a change request — with the charter, frozen baseline, contract, review and closure recorded.

## Gaps and work packages

- The vacuous closure → reopened and re-closed with the record (this document set).
- The missing typed artefacts → seven approved artefact rows.
- The missing TOGAF documents → the seven published documents of this set.
- The acceptance of the deliverables → change `01a2052e-5648…`, approved.
